text: Fat burners, BCAAs, test boosters, three pre-workouts... I need them all!
Let's rank what's actually worth your money.
Worth it: creatine, protein powder for convenience, and vitamin D if you're low.
Maybe: caffeine or pre-workout, and omega-3 if you don't eat fish.
Skip: fat burners, L-carnitine for fat loss, and BCAAs if you already eat enough protein.
Spend your money on food first. Save this.
